name: icbin
description: ICBIN is a vision benchmark (part of the BOP suite) for 6D object pose estimation in cluttered scenes, measuring how well algorithms recover objects' 6D poses from RGB/RGB-D images. It evaluates robustness to occlusion, clutter and real-world imaging conditions. Typical usage is to benchmark object detection/pose estimation and segmentation pipelines in robotics and AR/industrial settings.
reputation: Well-known within the 6D object pose estimation community as part of the BOP benchmark suite.
